name: Rosewood London
positioning: Rosewood London, in the former Pearl Assurance headquarters at 252 High Holborn near the Inns of Court, entered through an archway into an Edwardian courtyard, with Holborn Dining Room, The Pie Room, the Mirror Room and Scarfes Bar
best_for: Travelers who want a central London base near the Inns of Court
Lovers of British pies and British cooking
Groups who want a multi-bedroom suite with personal butler service

facts.text: The hotel is at 252 High Holborn, London WC1V 7EN.
The hotel is near the Inns of Court.
The building used to be the headquarters of Pearl Assurance.
An archway leads under the columns of an ornate facade into a grand Edwardian courtyard.
Communal spaces are all marble and mahogany with a neutral color palette.
Holborn Dining Room serves traditional British dishes with a twist and adjoins The Terrace and The Pie Room.
The Mirror Room serves breakfast, afternoon tea and dinner, with fine wines and a Champagne Bar set against a mirrored backdrop.
Sense, a Rosewood Spa offers personalised treatments that combine ancient healing traditions with modern techniques.
Beds are wrapped in Rivolta Carmignani Italian linen.
Bathroom toiletries are by DR Harris, which has sold bath products in London since the 18th century.
Rooms have Shakespeare quotes engraved in the glass-topped tables.
Tally Ho! Bike Tours explore London's landmarks and secret spots on a vintage British hand-built bike.

highlights.text: Scarfes Bar serves cocktails and spirits in a setting inspired by Gerald Scarfe's illustrations.
The Pie Room is a dedicated pie kitchen for handcrafted British pies, offering private dining, masterclasses and a takeaway hatch.
The Art Afternoon Tea, served in the Mirror Room, is inspired by Claude Monet.
The signature suites, designed and curated by Tony Chi and Associates, range up to eight bedrooms and feature personal butler service.
The Manor House Wing has five bedrooms, six bathrooms and its own private elevator.

considerations.text: The hotel is on one of London's busiest thoroughfares.
The spa gets busy, so treatments should be booked ahead.
WhataHotel notes ultra-luxury pricing reflecting the premium positioning.
